# Lip Sync

Lip-sync a video from your MegaScenes library to an audio track: the same video, with the mouth matched to the new words.

## What it does
Pick a video of a face and an audio track from your MegaScenes library, and get the same video with the lips matched to the new audio. Useful for dubbing, replacing a line of dialogue or a translated version of your own clip. For dubbing, voice-overs, explainers and short social clips. Claude tells you the price first and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you say yes.

**How the files are made:** each clip is generated by a video model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Limitations: for videos of yourself or of people who agreed to it; it does not make a real or famous person appear to say words they did not say. The video and the audio must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install lip-sync@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Lip Sync talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/lip-sync/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each clip uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Clips take one to a few minutes: Claude checks on progress, and the clip plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps (a link in Claude Code).

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_lip_sync_models` | Models for lip sync videos with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_lip_sync_cost` | Exact price of one lip sync video before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_lip_sync` | Starts one lip sync video in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_lip_sync` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_media` | Your videos and recordings, uploads and files made here, with their length, to pick the ones to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Lip-sync my latest MegaScenes video to my latest recording"
- "Which of my videos can I lip-sync?"
- "Match the lips in my last clip to my new voice-over"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the clip (the video and the recording you pick from your library) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
